biography.bio:
The millionaire who founded M.A.S.K. and leads it from the driver's seat - calm, decisive and always one move ahead of Miles Mayhem. Raising his son Scott between missions.

Masks: Spectrum, Ultra-Flash, Lava Shot, Shroud, Dolphin, Arrow, Lasertron, New Spectrum (wearing Spectrum).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.NSe8OtBT0HgjTIHs]{Coast Patrol}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.IaXyNYHkBdjkUj0E]{Goliath I}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.xEq6AhMte9FBtfq8]{Hornet}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.JZZUwsWQRvHYqj74]{Jungle Challenge}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.RuplqQVUeVIW6Mst]{Rhino}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.BdXhXgxDSdQmNXhd]{Skybolt}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.0HnrSo2XV3c7VFpy]{Skybolt Turbo Car}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.VAFsNOAKyg90Se1z]{Thunderhawk}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.DCgFWtq2Nz9EEHUU]{Volcano}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
The M.A.S.K. leader's signature mask: a sensor-packed helmet whose visor fires a focused laser, throws out a pulse of sound, or sweeps the area across the whole spectrum of light.

Matt Trakker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

options.label: Laser Beam: 2 Laser damage to one target
Sonic Waves: 1 Sonic damage and Deafened, enemies within 10 ft

steps.text: {name} sweeps the area with Spectrum Vision.

automation.notes: Laser and Sonic Waves roll against the targets and post Apply Damage buttons; Sonic Waves deafens on a hit. Spectrum Vision gives an Edge on Alertness for the rest of the scene. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
A mask built around one trick: a blinding burst of light from the visor that leaves everyone caught in it seeing spots.

Matt Trakker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls Targeting against each targeted creature's Evasion; a hit leaves it Blinded until the end of its next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
A sonar mask for work at sea: it pings the water around the wearer and helps them swim like its namesake.

Matt Trakker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

steps.text: {name}'s Dolphin mask starts pinging the water.

automation.notes: Sonar: for the scene, an Edge on Alertness and Athletics and a Swim speed of at least 30 ft. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
Pumps out a bank of thick fog to hide the wearer - handy at the end of a race gone wrong.

Matt Trakker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

steps.text: {name} vanishes into a bank of fog.

automation.notes: Gives the wearer Cover until the end of their next turn. Who else the fog hides is up to the GM. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
Hurls bolts of electricity from the visor - built for a jet-pack pilot who can't carry a rifle.

Matt Trakker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
Lobs blobs of molten rock that splash and keep burning.

Matt Trakker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
The upgraded Spectrum: its laser, plus a holographic double of the wearer to draw fire.

Matt Trakker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Holo-Double: +2 Evasion until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You and your mask are one. Rolls made with your mask's power are upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: an attack from one of your mask's Use buttons is upshifted once.

system.description:
A Laser Command mask that focuses its flash into a cutting beam - and dazzles anyone hit hard.

Matt Trakker's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. A hit of two degrees or more also Blinds. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
Money opens doors. Once per mission, your fortune or your contacts produce something the team needs: a ride, a plane ticket, a building pass, a piece of gear.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

steps.text: {name} pulls some strings - money talks. (GM: a vehicle, travel or a piece of gear of Standard Availability or lower turns up.)

automation.notes:
Use button: once per mission, posts it to chat.

Left to the table: what turns up.

system.description:
You know your ride like your own hands. A vehicle you are driving has +1 Evasion and Edge on its Driving Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive gets +1 Evasion, and its Driving Tests have Edge.
